status: REJECTED for adoption after actual visual review. Isolated experiment only; held candidate and public release remain unchanged. Technical tests passing do not establish art improvement.
experiment: Increase local soil/moss contrast, then account for the detail texture having eight aggregates per tile in derivative-based filtering; filter the finer pore field before nonlinear amplification and share clod field with roughness. Original palette restored in final source after wider colors read as camouflage.
visualDecision: Root reviewed original and candidate gameplay/detail High views, Low gameplay view and actual connected four-class party/HUD. Wider palette strengthens irregular pixel patches and is rejected. Filtering removes excessive grain contrast but leaves large bare brown-green washes and sparse repeated vegetation; this still falls short of the explicit modern ARPG visual contract. Do not promote a technically cleaner but visibly under-detailed surface as completion or ship a microrelease.
